title: On May 19 and 20 of this year, BSU named after K. Karasaev successfully passed accreditation by the external expert commission of the accreditation agency "Bilim Standard"

blocks.text: A group of 10 leading experts from Kyrgyzstan and the Republic of Kazakhstan conducted a thorough assessment of the compliance of educational programs of BSU named after K. Karasayev with quality standards.

The accreditation covered 14 bachelor's, master's and PhD educational programs. The experts conducted a comprehensive analysis of the educational process, including visiting all structural divisions and departments. The assessment included the level of teaching, the quality of educational programs, human resources, as well as the university's interaction with employers and graduates. As part of the procedure, interviews were organized with teachers, staff, students and representatives of employers to objectively assess the level of training of specialists and their demand in the labor market.

Rector of BSU Dyldaev M.M. emphasized the importance of accreditation for the university: "BSU strives to continuously improve educational programs. Passing independent accreditation is the most important stage in the development of our university. It allows us not only to confirm the current level of quality, but also to identify areas requiring improvement."
